brief:
Israeli occupation forces shot and killed Fathi Khazem during an incursion into his home in the al-Dowar al-Riyasi area of central Jenin, the Ma'an news agency reported. Khazem was the father of two sons, Raed and Abd al-Rahman, who had been previously killed.

The raid marked another military operation in the West Bank city, where Israeli forces have conducted repeated incursions in recent periods. The circumstances surrounding the deaths of Khazem's two sons were not detailed in the initial report of his killing.
title: Israeli forces kill father of two slain sons in Jenin home raid
